import MilneLib.SymmetricPower.SymmetricPower
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Geometrically.Reduced

/-!
# Geometric reducedness of finite relative powers

Finite relative powers of a geometrically reduced scheme locally of finite type
over a field are geometrically reduced. This supplies the reducedness input for
the finite-group quotient construction in Milne III.3, Proposition 3.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib

private theorem geometricallyReduced_comp_of_flat
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [GeometricallyReduced f] [Flat f] [GeometricallyReduced g]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] : GeometricallyReduced (f ≫ g) := by
  rw [geometricallyReduced_iff, geometrically_iff_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
  intro K _ y
  haveI : IsReduced (pullback g y) :=
    pullback_of_geometrically GeometricallyReduced.geometrically_isReduced K y
  haveI : IsReduced (pullback f (pullback.fst g y)) := inferInstance
  exact isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso g y f).inv

/-- Finite relative powers of geometrically reduced schemes locally of finite
type over a field are geometrically reduced, including the zeroth power. -/
theorem relativePower_geometricallyReduced {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (V : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (n : ℕ)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType V.hom] [GeometricallyReduced V.hom] :
    GeometricallyReduced (relativePower V n).hom := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    let S := Spec (CommRingCat.of k)
    have h : IsTerminal (relativePower V 0) :=
      isLimitEquivIsTerminalOfIsEmpty (Over S) _
        (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin 0 => V)))
    let e : relativePower V 0 ≅ Over.mk (𝟙 S) := h.uniqueUpToIso Over.mkIdTerminal
    apply (MorphismProperty.over_iso_iff (@GeometricallyReduced) e).mpr
    rw [geometricallyReduced_iff, geometrically_iff_of_isClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    intro K _ y
    change IsReduced (pullback (𝟙 S) y)
    haveI : IsIso (pullback.snd (𝟙 S) y) := inferInstance
    exact isReduced_of_isOpenImmersion (pullback.snd (𝟙 S) y)
  | succ n ih =>
    letI := ih
    letI := relativePower_locallyOfFiniteType V n
    let W := relativePower V n
    have h := extendFanIsLimit (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => V)
      (limit.isLimit (Discrete.functor (fun _ : Fin n => V)))
      (prodIsProd V W)
    let e : V ⨯ W ≅ relativePower V (n + 1) :=
      h.conePointUniqueUpToIso (limit.isLimit _)
    apply (MorphismProperty.over_iso_iff (@GeometricallyReduced) e).mp
    haveI : GeometricallyReduced (pullback.snd V.hom W.hom ≫ W.hom) :=
      geometricallyReduced_comp_of_flat _ _
    have he : (V ⨯ W).hom = (Over.prodLeftIsoPullback V W).hom ≫
        (pullback.snd V.hom W.hom ≫ W.hom) := by
      simp
    rw [he]
    exact (MorphismProperty.cancel_left_of_respectsIso (@GeometricallyReduced) _ _).mpr
      inferInstance

end MilneLib
